query: UPDATE invoices SET subtotal = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(unit_price * quantity) FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_id = $1 AND tenant_id = $2), 0), tax_amount = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(unit_price * quantity * tax_percent / 100) FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_id = $1 AND tenant_id = $2), 0), total_amount = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_price) FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_id = $1 AND tenant_id = $2), 0), updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1 AND tenant_id = $2
